title: The directed cone of a random orientation on a torus
claim: For any orientation of a square-lattice torus and any primitive period d, exactly one of: a directed closed walk W with det([W], d) < 0, or a dual directed closed walk of class d. Hence the primitive classes of directed closed walks are exactly the primitive periods of a closed convex cone C, and the dual's are exactly those of its polar; under a twist C is {0}, a line or the plane. For the uniform orientation the law of C is invariant under the polar map and the torus symmetries; on square tori P(no horizontal winding) = P(pure vertical directed cycles both ways), P(positive horizontal winding) = 1 - P(pure horizontal directed cycle), and the conjectured 3/4 is equivalent to P(no directed horizontal winding) = 1/4.
failure_conditions: An orientation and primitive period with both or neither of: a negative-pairing directed closed walk, a dual directed closed walk of that class.
Realized primitive classes that are not the primitive periods of a convex cone, or dual classes that are not those of the polar.
A twisted orientation whose realized classes are not symmetric under negation.
foundation_claim_scope: Directed homology of orientations of square-lattice tori and its laws under uniform and twisted random orientations. Lattices are declared; no space or physics is claimed.

validation.status: checked: prose proof; check.py verifies on 9,800 sampled orientations of eight small tori (untwisted 3 x 3, 3 x 4, 4 x 4 and sheared 3 x 3; twisted 3 x 3 with twists (1,0) and (1,1), 4 x 3, sheared 3 x 3) that exactly one of Bellman-Ford negative pairing and a dual walk of class d holds for every primitive period |d| <= 2, that realized classes are the primitive periods of a cone and the dual's of its polar, that twisted cones are {0}, a line or the plane with symmetric classes, polar invariance of the law of cone types, and the two square-torus identities on 5 x 5 by sampling; two controls rejected; searches are confined to a box of the universal cover; no human or external review
validation.level: V1 prose proof with exhaustive and sampled checks
